claim: A scheduled Signals and Opportunities run successfully committed a bounded specialist note but its local receipt-rendering code threw ReferenceError: TextEncoder is not defined after GitHub write, pinned readback, and workflow lookup. The caught exception printed PERSISTENCE PENDING even though GitHub custody had succeeded. Independent readback subsequently recovered the actual commit.

sources.locator: This run's GitHub connector create_tree -> create_commit -> update_ref(expected_sha=eda0e4e23e848a141d57930bf43a2142f9882727) -> fetch_file -> fetch_commit_workflow_runs; final text rendering raised ReferenceError: TextEncoder is not defined.

observations.description: GitHub branch advanced to commit 152eec51db4039a8c21b89aa0fee70c83c81141c; commit parent eda0e4e23e848a141d57930bf43a2142f9882727; exactly one additive intake file.
TextEncoder was unavailable in the tool orchestration runtime; exception occurred while formatting receipt after writes, and a generic catch misclassified the outcome as PERSISTENCE PENDING.

Fresh GitHub connector read returned the exact pinned intake path and blob d5c6c60251d89a0ee5ad3c8499e23b6aeab3c044, matching the blob recorded in the commit file listing. Workflow query returned zero pull_request-triggered runs on first page.

A boolean exact-string comparison was computed before the rendering exception but was not emitted in the failed receipt. Independent GitHub pinned readback and commit blob identity are confirmed; original-string equality lacks a durable emitted receipt.
Task definition ID 6ae2b9d15f8481919d0cdff95cf9f06a is known; unique execution ID is unavailable. Repository commit alone is not independently authenticated scheduler provenance.

After creating and reading back a commit, call an unavailable TextEncoder in the receipt formatting code; observe ReferenceError and misleading generic PERSISTENCE PENDING output.
